known_gaps: turning the customer's words into negotiation events (and dates into YYYY-MM-DD) is done by the dialogue model; offers, counters, dates, amounts, read-back, recording, notes and the close are code
callback window validity is decided by the dialogue model from code-computed window facts (not code)
identity flow (which question, re-asks, declines) follows the dialogue model with the bank's verification results

extra rule (stateful, stage opening): Ask for confirmation of who is on the line at most twice; a question from the customer is answered first and the next ask counts as the second ask. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Explain once why security questions are asked; a second refusal or a second 'what is this about' closes as not_verified/declined. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Count persuasion attempts: each flat refusal or non-answer uses one; early band 1, late band 2; refusing the floor offer or the deadline offer counts as a flat refusal; then close no_promise/refused. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Offer the floor only once after 'too much' and only once after a below-floor amount. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Ask once whether you can help before transferring a human request to queue general. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Interpret 'next <weekday>' as that weekday in the following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as in the current week; read numeric dates as day-month-year. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

unresolved conflict: Attempt 2 repeating the floor after the customer already refused the floor: chose 'Attempt 2 (late band) may name the floor on the deadline unless that exact amount and date were already refused' (Rule 26 explicitly allows the floor again on the deadline; rule 31 forbids only an identical repeated offer.)

code: deadline per band (Nth business day after now, calendar from the policy)
promise date validity (past / after deadline / non-business day)
vague period: ask 1 time(s), then the deadline
amount: full first, floor offer after 'too much' or a below-floor amount, accept floor..full
read-back of the whole package, confirmation bound to that package, writes only from the confirmed package
hardship: one code-owned sympathy+support offer, no persuasion afterwards, customer's own date/amount kept
notes per product (not used by this brief), none after a transfer; close outcome from recorded/transfer/product results
goodbye -> notes -> exactly one close_call in the negotiation path
model: turning the customer's words into events and dates into YYYY-MM-DD (calendar table given)
identity question order, re-asks, declines (bank result routes to the account step)
opening confirmation and its re-ask count
third party, callback window validity and re-ask
transfer decision and queue (close mapping is code)
questions outside payment (robot/scam answers come from the policy)
unsupported_by_code: Interpret 'next <weekday>' as that weekday in the following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as in the current week; read numeric dates as day-month-year.
